spec_match.rationale: Removes a real same-origin iframe and observes the exact three events (pagehide, visibilitychange, unload) the deprecation omits, distinguishing synchronous-inside-remove() from later delivery.

interactive.rationale: Remove / insert-fresh / navigation-control buttons with a live timeline and verdict.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index card promises the single-removal probe and control-backed verdict, and the page delivers both.

edge_cases.rationale: The navigation control arm proves listeners work before a silent removal is called 'omitted'. The inconclusive branch is reported, not hidden. The related blur behaviour is shown but explicitly excluded from the verdict.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/<id> plus the spec/explainer sections it exercises.

conformance.rationale: Same contract as the suite's no-pagehide/no-unload/no-visibilitychange script assertions, which fail honestly on unflagged Chrome.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 (Playwright) at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch: default branch observed (all three events synchronous inside remove()); control navigation delivered pagehide/visibilitychange/unload; zero console errors; 0px overflow. With --enable-blink-features=OmitSubframeDetachmentEventsOnRemoval, Chromium 153 still fired the events, so the omitted branch is not yet observed.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts legacy branch, omitted branch, inconclusive branch, navigation control and widget load failure.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; buttons override both background and color; verdict colours use emerald-dark/rose on stone; no raw hex.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons/checkbox with labels, timeline is an aria-live ordered list, verdicts role=status/aria-live, visible focus, 44px targets.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Driven at both classes with 0px overflow and full-width iframe host.

openQuestions.title: Capture the omitted branch on a build where the flag takes effect
openQuestions.detail: Chromium 153 ignores --enable-blink-features=OmitSubframeDetachmentEventsOnRemoval (the compat study used 156.0.8078.79). Re-run on Canary with the flag and record the 'Events omitted' verdict plus the control pass.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible status live region announce async result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce asynchronous results via polite live regions; keep native buttons/labels; visible focus.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verdicts/outputs are role=status or aria-live=polite; all controls are native buttons/inputs with visible text labels and a 3px focus outline; min 44px targets.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsic grid tracks (minmax(min(100%, Xrem), 1fr)) and wrap long monospace strings so nothing overflows at 360px.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Card grids use minmax(min(100%,…),1fr); outputs use overflow-wrap:anywhere; measured 0px horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3.

guidanceConsulted.query: form controls radio group fieldset legend accessible
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Group related radios/checkboxes in fieldset+legend and label every control.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Option groups use fieldset/legend or wrapping labels; range inputs have associated label+output.

summary: Real removal probe with a control arm that makes the 'omitted' verdict sound. Today it shows the deprecated synchronous behaviour, and the flagged path is still unobserved on the available Chromium.
